metadata.title: US Municipality Directory - Arsenal e-Directory
metadata.description: All incorporated US places from 2024 Census Bureau Gazetteer with 2020 Decennial Census population data. Includes cities, towns, villages, boroughs, and other incorporated places.
metadata.source_gazetteer: 2024 Census Bureau National Gazetteer Places File
metadata.funcstat_filter: A (active), B (jointly functioning), C (consolidated city), F (place+county)
metadata.excludes: CDPs (census designated places, unincorporated) and inactive/nonfunctioning places
metadata.county_note: county field is null -- incorporated places can span multiple counties. Enrich with Census Geocoder API using lat/long if county lookup is needed.
